This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|

| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. - `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

159	### 4.2 drive 轮询循环：一份代码代替八份纪律
160	
161	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
162	
163	`drive` 是整个 step 契约的**心脏起搏器**：它不认识任何模型，却规定了两件事——**每迭代发生什么**（顺序）与**每迭代至多对外说什么**（一条 `StepOutputs`）。把 u3-l3/u3-l4 的两块拼图放进来就完整了：
164	
165	- u3-l3 说「一个调度器步产出一条 `StepOutputs`」——**谁把『步』定义成迭代、谁保证恰一条**？`drive`。
166	- u3-l4 说「`commit_step`/`fail_all` 只有 driver 能碰」——**driver 在哪调用它们**？`drive`。
167	
168	「约定变代码」清单：
169	
170	| 若散落到各模型 crate 的约定 | 写错的风险 | `drive` 里的落点 |
171	|---|---|---|
172	| 每迭代先收请求再干活 | 先干活后收请求 → 新请求多等一整步 | 内层排空循环（先于 `step`） |
173	| 提交先开户再交给调度器 | 调度器拿到无账户请求，记账必 panic | `register` → `submit` 的固定顺序 |
174	| 每迭代恰好一次 commit | 多次 commit → 一步拆成多条消息，压扁保证失效；漏 commit → 更新滞留 | L84 恰一次 `commit_step` |
175	| metrics 每迭代发布一次 | 读者读到陈旧 gauge，路由决策失真 | L82-L83 快照 + 发布 |
176	| 致命错误要写销**全部**在途请求 | 客户端挂死等待 | `fail_all` + 再 commit 一次 |
177	| 空闲时如何自旋 | `sleep` 引入毫秒级尾延迟 | `std::hint::spin_loop` |
178	| 前端关闭后何时退出 | 过早退出丢请求；过晚退出线程泄漏 | 断连 **且** 快照排空，二者兼备 |
179	
180	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
181	
182	`drive` 的一次迭代（与真实代码逐行对应，见 4.2.3）：
183	
184	```
185	外层 loop
186	 ├─ ① 内层 loop：排空 submissions（crossbeam try_recv）
187	 │     Ok(envelope)   → ledger.register(envelope) → scheduler.submit(queued)
188	 │     Err(Empty)     → break（现在没有，继续本迭代）
189	 │     Err(Disconn.)  → submissions_open = false; break（永远没有，进入关停判定）
190	 ├─ ② step = scheduler.step(&mut ledger)          ← 本迭代的全部工作与记账
191	 ├─ ③ snapshot = scheduler.metrics()
192	 │    metrics_changed = metrics.publish(&snapshot) ← 写共享单元
193	 ├─ ④ ledger.commit_step(metrics_changed)          ← 至多发出一条 StepOutputs
194	 ├─ ⑤ step == Err？
195	 │     是 → log::error → ledger.fail_all("engine fatal: {错误原文}")
196	 │          → ledger.commit_step(false) 把写销冲出去 → return（线程结束）
197	 │     否 ↓
198	 └─ ⑥ snapshot 空转（running == 0 且 waiting == 0）？
199	        submissions_open == false → log::info → return（排空退出）
200	        否则 → std::hint::spin_loop() → 回到 ①
201	```
202	
203	三个容易错过的细节：
204	
205	1. **致命迭代的「遗言」也会被发出**：`step` 返回 `Err` 前可能已经记了半步账（比如 `admit` 之后才崩）——L84 的 `commit_step` 在错误检查**之前**，所以这些部分更新先落地；随后 `fail_all` 只写销**仍然开着**的账户（已 finish 的不受影响），再由第二次 `commit_step(false)` 冲出去。线上顺序：部分更新 → `Failed` terminals。
206	2. **空转判定用的是本迭代的快照**：③ 拍的 `snapshot` 在 ⑥ 复用，不再重拍——`step` 之后到下一次 `step` 之间调度器状态不变（单线程独占），所以快照永远新鲜。
207	3. **「一条 `StepOutputs`」不等于「每迭代必有消息」**：`commit_step` 在「更新为空 **且** metrics 未变」时**不发**（见 4.2.3 的账本侧代码）。空转的迭代对外完全静默；而「metrics 变了但更新为空」会发一条 `updates` 为空的**唤醒消息**——这正是 wiring.rs 文档说的「metrics are a shared cell, with changes signaled on the step stream」。

269	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
270	
271	`Scheduler` trait 与 `drive` 循环之间还差一层**装配**：谁来把「一个裸的调度器值」变成「一个跑着的服务分区」？答案是一次调用：
272	
273	```rust
274	let partition: LiveScheduler = spawn_scheduler("echo", EchoScheduler::default());
275	```
276	
277	`spawn_scheduler` 做三件事：
278	
279	1. **铸接线**：`scheduler_pair()` 一次铸出双端——前端端 `SchedulerHandle`、调度器端 `SchedulerBackend`（内含提交通道接收端、**崭新的账本**、metrics 发布器、退出守卫）。因为两端一体铸出，模型 crate 既不能接错线也不能忘接线（u3-l6 详讲）。
280	2. **起线程**：用 `std::thread::Builder` 起一个**命名** OS 线程跑 `drive(scheduler, backend)`——调度器值与 backend 一起被 move 进线程，从此单所有权。
281	3. **交回 `LiveScheduler { handle, join }`**：`handle` 是前端的交互面（提交/步流/metrics/`exited()`），`join` 是线程的 `JoinHandle`——按 [wiring.rs:L155-L160](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs#L155-L160) 的注释，它由 server 在关停时、**drop 掉全部 handle 之后** join。
282	
283	「跑几个调度器、每个是什么含义（DP 副本？）」完全是模型线的决定，契约只搬运 `Vec<LiveScheduler>` 不附加 rank 语义——echo 线恰好一个（[echo-server.rs:L78-L92](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs#L78-L92)），qwen3 线可能按 DP 分区数 spawn 多个。
284	
285	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
286	
287	一次提交在接线路上的完整旅程（把 4.1/4.2 的循环串起来）：

289	```
290	前端侧                                   调度器线程（drive 循环）
291	──────                                   ──────────────────────
292	SchedulerHandle::submit(request)
293	 │ 铸 RequestId（原子自增）
294	 │ 铸 abort 标志 → RequestControl 返回给调用方
295	 │ 打包 RequestEnvelope（含 drop 炸弹 + queued_at）
296	 │ crossbeam send ──────────────────────→ ① try_recv 收到
297	 │                                          register(envelope) 开户
298	 │                                          scheduler.submit(queued)
299	 │                                       ② scheduler.step(&mut ledger)
300	 │                                          admit/push_tokens/finish…
301	 │                                       ④ commit_step → tokio mpsc send
302	 take_steps() 的接收端 ←────────────────── StepOutputs { updates }
303	 （协议栈翻译循环消费）
304	```

340	**练习 1**：调度器线程已经因致命错误退出后，前端再调 `handle.submit(request)` 会发生什么？请求的客户端会看到什么？
341	
342	**参考答案**：`submit` 照常铸造 id、abort 标志与信封，然后 `submit_tx.send(envelope)` 返回 `Err`（接收端已随线程销毁）——代码（[wiring.rs:L91-L93](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs#L91-L93)）把退回的信封直接 `drop`，触发它的 **drop 炸弹**：在步流上以一条 `Failed` terminal 回答该请求。所以 `submit` 永不失败、客户端永不挂死——错误以普通 terminal 的形态流出，与正常终态同一条通路。`handle` 里专门留着 `step_tx` 的 clone（[wiring.rs:L73-L75](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs#L73-L75)）就是为这条路径服务的。
343	
344	**练习 2**：`handle.exited()` 在哪三种情况下会解析（resolve）？
345	
346	**参考答案**：见 [wiring.rs:L109-L113](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs#L109-L113) 的文档——「after a fatal step or a drained shutdown, or its thread has unwound」：① `step` 返回致命 `Err`，driver 写销后 `return`；② 前端 drop 全部 handle、调度器排空后的优雅退出；③ 线程 panic unwind（比如 u3-l4 的记账违规 panic）。三者最终都 drop `exit_guard`（`DropGuard`），取消 `exited` 令牌。

348	**练习 3**：`MetricsPublisher::publish` 为什么要返回「是否变化」这个布尔值，而不是让读者自己去比较？
349	
350	**参考答案**：因为读者（协议栈、路由器）只在**被唤醒时**才去读共享单元，而「该醒了」的信号恰恰是步流上的空 `StepOutputs` 消息——是否发这条消息由 `commit_step(metrics_changed)` 决定。若 publish 不返回变化标志，driver 就得自己持有上一份快照做比较（多一份状态、多一处出错面）。`publish` 内部一行 `*current != *snapshot` 顺手算出（[wiring.rs:L59-L64](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs#L59-L64)），`SchedulerMetrics` 派生 `PartialEq` 正是为此。这是「发布者知道变化、读者被变化唤醒」的完整闭环。

364	// 示例代码：EchoScheduler 的「每步两 token」变体
365	#[derive(Default)]
366	struct TwoTokenScheduler {
367	    queued: Vec<(RequestId, usize)>,
368	    running: Vec<(RequestId, usize)>,
369	}
370	
371	impl Scheduler for TwoTokenScheduler {
372	    fn submit(&mut self, request: QueuedRequest) {
373	        self.queued.push((request.id, request.request.max_tokens)); // 只转移
374	    }
375	
376	    fn step(&mut self, ledger: &mut RequestLedger) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
377	        for (id, max_tokens) in self.queued.drain(..) {
378	            ledger.admit(id);                       // 裁决全在 step 里
379	            self.running.push((id, max_tokens));
380	        }
381	        let mut still_running = Vec::new();
382	        for (id, max_tokens) in self.running.drain(..) {
383	            if ledger.is_aborted(id) {
384	                ledger.retire(id);
385	                continue;
386	            }
387	            let next = ledger.completion_tokens(id) as u32;   // 读账本流水
388	            let batch: Vec<u32> = (next..(next + 2).min(max_tokens as u32)).collect();
389	            if batch.is_empty() {
390	                ledger.finish(id, FinishReason::Length);      // 上一轮恰好做满
391	                continue;
392	            }
393	            ledger.push_tokens(id, &batch, &[]);
394	            if ledger.completion_tokens(id) >= max_tokens {
395	                ledger.finish(id, FinishReason::Length);
396	            } else {
397	                still_running.push((id, max_tokens));
398	            }
399	        }
400	        self.running = still_running;
401	        Ok(())
402	    }
403	
404	    fn metrics(&self) -> SchedulerMetrics {
405	        SchedulerMetrics {
406	            num_running_reqs: self.running.len() as u64,
407	            num_waiting_reqs: self.queued.len() as u64,
408	            ..SchedulerMetrics::default()
409	        }
410	    }
411	}

476	## 6. 本讲小结
477	
478	- **`Scheduler` 三方法就是模型线的全部运行时义务**：`submit` 只做所有权转移（裁决延迟到 `step` 零代价，因为 driver 每迭代 commit 一次）、`step` 是唯一裁决点与唯一记账点、`metrics` 是 `&self` 只读快照；超出三方法的能力（如 LoRA 控制通道）由调度器自己捕获、在自己的 `step` 里排空。
479	- **`drive` 把循环纪律写成了代码**：每迭代固定四拍——排空提交（每条先 `register` 开户再 `submit` 转移）→ `step` → 快照并 `publish` metrics → `commit_step` 恰好一次；八条模型线共享同一份骨架，不存在八份人肉纪律。
480	- **「一条 `StepOutputs`」有三档**：有更新则带更新发出；无更新但 metrics 变了则发一条 `updates` 为空的**唤醒消息**（读者该去重读共享单元）；两者皆无则**完全静默**——空转迭代对外不可见。
481	- **致命路径**：`step` 返回 `Err` → 本迭代的半步账先照常 commit → `fail_all("engine fatal: {错误原文}")` 写销**每一个**未答复请求（含调度器跟丢的）→ 再 commit 一次冲出发送 → 线程返回，`exit_guard` drop 使 `handle.exited()` 解析。
482	- **退出与空闲**：优雅退出要求「提交通道断开 **且** 最新快照 running/waiting 均为 0」；空转迭代以 `std::hint::spin_loop` 放松发射端口但绝不睡眠——有活干的迭代永远到不了这条 hint。
483	- **`spawn_scheduler` 是装配点**：`scheduler_pair` 铸双端（前端 `SchedulerHandle` / 调度器 `SchedulerBackend`，账本出生即握步流发送端）→ 命名线程跑 `drive` → 交回 `LiveScheduler { handle, join }`；`handle.submit` 永不失败——调度器已死时由信封 drop 炸弹以 `Failed` terminal 作答。

# Scheduler trait 与 drive 轮询循环

## 1. 本讲目标

[u3-l4](u3-l4-request-ledger.md) 结尾留下了一个关键结论：`register`、`commit_step`、`fail_all` 是 `pub(crate)`，**节奏（cadence）由 driver 拥有**。本讲就把这个「driver」完整拆开——它是 [driver.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs) 里那个不到 50 行的轮询循环 `drive`，加上铸造接线的 `spawn_scheduler`。读完本讲你应当能够：

1. **说出 `Scheduler` 三个方法的分工**：`submit` 只做所有权转移、`step` 是唯一裁决点（也是唯一写账本的地方）、`metrics` 供驱动循环每迭代发布一次快照——模型线的全部运行时义务就这三个方法，多一点也不给。
2. **走查 `drive` 循环的顺序保证**：先排空提交通道（每条先 `register` 再 `submit`）、再 `step`、再快照并发布 metrics、再 `commit_step` 恰好一次；然后是致命错误路径与空闲自旋。
3. **解释致命错误路径**：`step` 返回 `Err` → 账本 `fail_all` 把错误原文写销**每一个**未答复请求 → 再 commit 一次让写销落地 → 线程退出。
4. **用 `spawn_scheduler` + `SchedulerHandle` 跑通一次完整回路**：提交一个请求，从 `take_steps()` 取出的接收端读到 `Scheduled` 与 terminal。

本讲承接 [u3-l4](u3-l4-request-ledger.md)（账本）与 [u3-l3](u3-l3-step-wire.md)（线类型），是 [u3-l6](u3-l6-wiring-and-handle.md)（scheduler_pair 与多分区路由）的直接前置。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 轮询循环：一份代码代替八份纪律

PegaInfer 有八条模型线（qwen3、qwen35、deepseek-v2-lite、gemma4、kimi-k2、glm52、k3、qwen4），每条线都有自己的调度器。如果「每步先排空提交、再执行、再发 metrics、再统一提交、出错时写销全部请求、空闲时怎么自旋」这些**循环骨架**的约定散落在各模型 crate 里，那就是八份需要人肉保持一致的纪律——迟早漂移。driver.rs 的模块文档把这条设计决策说得很直白：

> The loop lives here — once, for every model line — so its conventions (drain order, one metrics publish and one commit per iteration, shutdown and fatal handling) are code, not per-crate discipline.
> （循环活在这里——每条模型线只此一份——于是它的约定（排空顺序、每迭代一次 metrics 发布与一次 commit、关停与致命处理）是代码，而不是各 crate 的纪律。）

见 [driver.rs:L1-L9](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L1-L9)。

这也是整个项目「EP free-running 纪律」（见仓库 CLAUDE.md：任何引擎循环都不停不等）在单个调度器上的本地版本：`drive` **从不睡眠、从不阻塞等待事件**，它全速转圈，靠 `try_recv` 非阻塞地试探提交通道。为什么敢这样烧 CPU？因为 `step` 的契约要求「空闲的调度器快速返回」——`step` 里没有 GPU 工作可做时立刻 `Ok(())`，循环马上进入下一轮探测。调度器自己 spawn 的 worker 线程（比如 CUDA 流上的完成）会在**一个 step 的粒度内**被拾起。

### 2.2 通道三件套：回顾与预告

[u3-l1](u3-l1-contract-overview.md) 已经画过 step 契约的接线图，这里只复习 `drive` 会碰到的三件套（全部由 `scheduler_pair` 一次铸出，详见 [u3-l6](u3-l6-wiring-and-handle.md)）：

| 方向 | 通道 | 生产者 | 消费者 | `drive` 侧的操作 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 提交 | crossbeam 无界 channel | 前端 `SchedulerHandle::submit` | 调度器线程 | `try_recv` 排空（不阻塞） |
| 步流 | tokio 无界 mpsc | 账本（经 `commit_step`） | 协议栈翻译循环 | 间接：`commit_step` 内 `send` |
| metrics | `Arc<Mutex<SchedulerMetrics>>` 共享单元 | 驱动循环每迭代写入 | 前端按需读 | `metrics.publish(&snapshot)` |

注意一个精妙的分工：**步流上「metrics 变了」这件事本身也用一条步流消息来信号**——发布前后快照不同时，`commit_step` 会发出一条 `updates` 为空的 `StepOutputs`，专门用来唤醒读者去重读共享单元（4.2.3 详解）。

### 2.3 两档错误：panic 与 `Err` 的边界

[u3-l4](u3-l4-request-ledger.md) 讲过账本对**记账违规**（对已关账户 `finish` 等）一律 panic——那是「生产者写错了代码」的档位。本讲处理另一档：`Scheduler::step` 返回的 `anyhow::Result<()>` 里的 `Err`，语义是**引擎本身不可再用**（GPU 故障、CUDA 上下文损坏这类）。两档错误在源码里泾渭分明：

- 记账违规 → panic 在调度器调用点（bug，修代码）；
- **可恢复的执行失败**（单个请求算错了）→ 调度器自己吸收：`fail` 掉被碰到的请求，继续服务（trait 文档原话）；
- `Err` → 引擎报废 → driver 写销全部在途请求然后收摊。

### 2.4 需要的 Rust 背景

- **`try_recv` 与 `TryRecvError`**：crossbeam 通道的非阻塞接收。`Empty` = 现在没消息（不代表永远没有）；`Disconnected` = 所有发送端都掉了（**永远**不会有消息了）。`drive` 用这两者的区别实现优雅关停判定。
- **`std::hint::spin_loop`**：一条 CPU 提示指令（x86 上是 `PAUSE`），告诉核心「我在短等待，让出发射端口」，但不放弃线程、不进内核。延迟近乎为零，代价是这一核持续轻负载空转——对「随时可能有请求进来」的引擎主循环，这正是想要的属性。
- **`std::thread::Builder::name(...).spawn(...)`**：起命名 OS 线程；线程名会出现在 `top -H`、gdb、panic 回溯里，便于运维定位「哪个调度器的线程在烧 CPU」。
- **`DropGuard`（tokio-util）**：持有时持有令牌，drop 时取消 `CancellationToken`。`SchedulerBackend.exit_guard` 就是它——driver 线程一旦返回（无论正常排空还是致命退出），前端的 `handle.exited()` 立刻可等待。
- **`anyhow::Result` 与 `{error:#}`**：anyhow 的错误链交替打印格式，`fail_all` 的写销消息里用它把深层上下文链完整带给客户端。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 | 本讲用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs` | **主角** | `Scheduler` trait、`spawn_scheduler`、`drive` 循环，以及三个可直接运行的测试（EchoScheduler、暂停调度器、致命注入） |
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/metrics.rs` | **主角** | `SchedulerMetrics` 快照的字段语义、「计数器必须是累计值」的设计论证 |
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs` | 辅：接线 | `SchedulerBackend`/`MetricsPublisher`/`SchedulerHandle`/`scheduler_pair`/`LiveScheduler`（u3-l6 主讲，本讲只取 `drive` 触到的面） |
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/ledger.rs` | 辅：账本 | 只看「Driver face」三方法：`register`、`commit_step`、`fail_all`（u3-l4 已精读其余） |
| `pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs` | 辅：参考实现 | 生产语境里的 `EchoScheduler`：`launch` 里 `spawn_scheduler`、三方法的完整写法 |
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs` | 辅：线类型 | `StepOutputs { updates }`——步流上每迭代至多一条消息（u3-l3 已精读） |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 Scheduler trait：模型线的运行时义务被压缩成三个方法

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

[u2-l1](u2-l1-model-line-trait.md) 讲过 `ModelLine` 是 server 与模型 crate 之间的接缝；本讲的 `Scheduler` 是**接缝的运行时半边**：模型线的引擎启动之后，留给前端的全部交互面就是这三个方法。三个方法各自被压缩到只剩一个职责：

- **`submit`：只做所有权转移**。请求负载（`QueuedRequest`）从驱动循环移进调度器自己的队列，**没有任何裁决**——接纳与否、拒绝与否，一概不在这里决定。为什么可以推迟？因为 driver 每迭代 commit 一次：`step` 里补记的裁决，与「submit 时立刻裁决」落在**同一条** `StepOutputs` 里，对外不可区分。晚裁决零代价，却让 `submit` 的签名干净到不能更干净：吃一个值，返回 `()`，不可能失败。
- **`step`：唯一裁决点**。接纳、GPU 工作、逐请求记账，全部发生在这一步里；账本上的每一笔业务写入（`admit`/`push_tokens`/`finish`/`retire`/…）都出自某个 `step` 的调用栈。trait 文档称之为「the single emission site」。
- **`metrics`：自画像快照**。返回一份 `SchedulerMetrics`，driver 每迭代取一次发布。注意它拿的是 `&self`——只读，不产生任何副作用。

一个容易忽略的边界声明也写在模块文档里：**超出三方法的能力（比如 LoRA 控制通道）不关契约的事**——需要额外通道的调度器在 spawn 之前自己把通道句柄捕获进结构体，在自己的 `step` 里排空它。契约拒绝为每种能力开一个方法。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```
驱动循环的一次迭代（概念版，4.2 精读真代码）

    ① 排空提交通道：
         for envelope in submissions.drain():
             queued = ledger.register(envelope)   ← 开户（driver 专属）
             scheduler.submit(queued)             ← 纯所有权转移，无裁决
    ② step = scheduler.step(&mut ledger)          ← 唯一裁决点 + GPU 工作 + 记账
    ③ snapshot = scheduler.metrics()              ← 自画像
       metrics_changed = metrics.publish(snapshot) ← 写共享单元，返回是否变化
    ④ ledger.commit_step(metrics_changed)         ← 本迭代全部更新 → 至多一条步流消息
    ⑤ step 为 Err？→ fail_all(错误原文) → commit_step(false) → 线程退出
    ⑥ 快照显示空转？→ 通道也断了就退出，否则 spin_loop 后回到 ①
```

trait 的三方法与这条循环的对应关系：

| 方法 | 在循环里的位置 | 契约限制 |
|---|---|---|
| `submit` | ① 内，每条提交一次 | 只转移；裁决延到 `step` 不丢失任何信息 |
| `step` | ②，每迭代恰好一次 | 可恢复失败自己吸收；`Err` = 引擎报废 |
| `metrics` | ③，每迭代恰好一次 | `&self` 只读快照 |

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

trait 定义本体（含全部三方法的契约注释）：

> [driver.rs:L18-L41](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L18-L41) —— `Scheduler` trait：`Send` 即可（跑在专属 OS 线程上，单所有权，不需要 `Sync`）。三个方法的文档注释就是契约正文。

拆开看三个签名：

```rust
fn submit(&mut self, request: QueuedRequest);                    // L27
fn step(&mut self, ledger: &mut RequestLedger) -> anyhow::Result<()>;  // L37
fn metrics(&self) -> SchedulerMetrics;                           // L40
```

三条值得逐字读的注释：

- [driver.rs:L21-L26](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L21-L26)：`submit` 的「Ownership transfer only — every verdict (admit/reject/retire) is written to the ledger from `step`, the single emission site. Nothing is lost by deferring」——晚裁决零代价的完整论证。
- [driver.rs:L29-L36](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L29-L36)：`step` 的两档失败语义——「Recoverable execution failures are the scheduler's to absorb (fail the touched requests, keep serving); `Err` means the engine is beyond use」，以及「driver 无停顿循环、空闲 step 快速返回、worker 线程的完成在一个 step 内被拾起」的轮询依据。
- [driver.rs:L39](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L39)：`metrics` 的「the driver publishes it once per iteration」。

再看两份参照实现（都是真实代码，读者可对照体会三方法的最小实现）：

> [driver.rs:L116-L162](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L116-L162) —— 测试用 `EchoScheduler`：每步每请求发一个 token，`max_tokens` 到量即 `finish(Length)`。`submit` 把 `(id, max_tokens)` 压进 `queued`；`step` 先把 `queued` 全部 `admit` 转 `running`，再对每个 running 请求查 abort → 读账本流水 `completion_tokens` → `push_tokens` → 到量 `finish`；`metrics` 现算 running/waiting 两个 gauge。

> [echo-server.rs:L116-L167](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs#L116-L167) —— 生产语境的 `EchoScheduler`（无 GPU 的完整模型线）：同样的三方法骨架，但 `step` 里多了真实的接纳决策——排队请求若已 abort 直接 `retire`，否则按 `prompt_tokens` 与 `max_tokens` 的较小值建逆序游标；每步弹一个 token，弹完按是否被截断选 `Stop` 或 `Length`。注意所有裁决（admit/retire/push/finish）**全部**写在 `step` 里，`submit` 只有一行 `push`。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：建立「三方法分工」的手感——亲眼确认所有账本写入都发生在 `step` 的调用栈里，`submit` 与 `metrics` 一行账都不碰。

**操作步骤**：

1. 打开 [driver.rs:L124-L162](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L124-L162) 与 [echo-server.rs:L116-L167](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs#L116-L167)，做一张三列对照表：方法 ×（两份 EchoScheduler 各做了什么 × 是否触碰 `ledger`）。
2. 统计两份实现里 `ledger.` 前缀调用的出现方法：`admit`、`is_aborted`、`retire`、`completion_tokens`、`push_tokens`、`finish`——逐个标记它出现在 `submit`/`step`/`metrics` 中的哪一个。预期：**全部且仅在 `step`**。
3. 回答：两份实现的 `metrics()` 为什么每次现算（`self.running.len()`）而不是缓存一个字段？提示：`metrics` 拿 `&self`，而队列长度在 `&mut self` 的 `step` 里变化；现算让「每迭代发布」天然正确，缓存则需要两处同步。

**需要观察的现象**：对照表里 `submit` 行与 `metrics` 行的「触碰 ledger」列全为否。

**预期结果**：三方法分工在这两份实现里零例外。此实践为纯阅读型，无需运行；结论可立即核验。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果把 `submit` 改成 `fn submit(&mut self, request: QueuedRequest) -> bool`（返回「是否接纳」，比如队列满时拒绝），会破坏契约的哪条性质？

**参考答案**：破坏「晚裁决零代价」。现在的论证是：`step` 里补记的裁决与 submit 时立即裁决落在同一条 `StepOutputs` 里（因为 driver 每迭代只 commit 一次）。一旦 `submit` 能当场拒绝，调度器就必须**在 submit 里写账本**（`reject` 需要记账才能让客户端收到 `Rejected` terminal），裁决写入点从「单一发射点 `step`」分裂成两处，u3-l4 讲的「节奏由 driver 拥有」随之瓦解；而且 `submit` 签名里根本没有 ledger 参数，这也是类型层面的明确拒绝。

**练习 2**：qwen3 线的 LoRA 适配器装卸是一个控制通道，为什么它不能成为 `Scheduler` 的第四个方法（比如 `fn lora_control(&mut self, ...)`）？

**参考答案**：模块文档（[driver.rs:L6-L9](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L6-L9)）明说：「Anything beyond them (e.g. LoRA control) is not the contract's business: a scheduler that serves an extra capability captures its own channel before spawn and drains it inside `step`」。契约面每加一个方法，八条模型线全都得面对它（哪怕多数线返回「不支持」）；而「捕获自己的通道、在自己的 `step` 里排空」把额外能力完全留在实现内部——不动 trait，driver 循环也不用为它加一轮排空。实际代码里 LoRA 控制走的是独立的 `LoraClient`（[u3-l1](u3-l1-contract-overview.md) 讲过 `Engine.lora: Option<LoraClient>`，`Option` 即能力）。

**练习 3**：`Scheduler` 的 trait 约束为什么只有 `Send`，不需要 `Sync`？

**参考答案**：调度器被 `spawn_scheduler` 移动进一个专属 OS 线程（[driver.rs:L45-L52](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L45-L52)），从此单线程独占所有权——任何时刻只有一个线程能碰它，不存在共享引用，自然不需要 `Sync`。这也让模型 crate 的实现自由度最大：内部可以用任何非 `Sync` 的类型（比如裸 CUDA 句柄的包装）。

### 4.2 drive 轮询循环：一份代码代替八份纪律

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`drive` 是整个 step 契约的**心脏起搏器**：它不认识任何模型，却规定了两件事——**每迭代发生什么**（顺序）与**每迭代至多对外说什么**（一条 `StepOutputs`）。把 u3-l3/u3-l4 的两块拼图放进来就完整了：

- u3-l3 说「一个调度器步产出一条 `StepOutputs`」——**谁把『步』定义成迭代、谁保证恰一条**？`drive`。
- u3-l4 说「`commit_step`/`fail_all` 只有 driver 能碰」——**driver 在哪调用它们**？`drive`。

「约定变代码」清单：

| 若散落到各模型 crate 的约定 | 写错的风险 | `drive` 里的落点 |
|---|---|---|
| 每迭代先收请求再干活 | 先干活后收请求 → 新请求多等一整步 | 内层排空循环（先于 `step`） |
| 提交先开户再交给调度器 | 调度器拿到无账户请求，记账必 panic | `register` → `submit` 的固定顺序 |
| 每迭代恰好一次 commit | 多次 commit → 一步拆成多条消息，压扁保证失效；漏 commit → 更新滞留 | L84 恰一次 `commit_step` |
| metrics 每迭代发布一次 | 读者读到陈旧 gauge，路由决策失真 | L82-L83 快照 + 发布 |
| 致命错误要写销**全部**在途请求 | 客户端挂死等待 | `fail_all` + 再 commit 一次 |
| 空闲时如何自旋 | `sleep` 引入毫秒级尾延迟 | `std::hint::spin_loop` |
| 前端关闭后何时退出 | 过早退出丢请求；过晚退出线程泄漏 | 断连 **且** 快照排空，二者兼备 |

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`drive` 的一次迭代（与真实代码逐行对应，见 4.2.3）：

```
外层 loop
 ├─ ① 内层 loop：排空 submissions（crossbeam try_recv）
 │     Ok(envelope)   → ledger.register(envelope) → scheduler.submit(queued)
 │     Err(Empty)     → break（现在没有，继续本迭代）
 │     Err(Disconn.)  → submissions_open = false; break（永远没有，进入关停判定）
 ├─ ② step = scheduler.step(&mut ledger)          ← 本迭代的全部工作与记账
 ├─ ③ snapshot = scheduler.metrics()
 │    metrics_changed = metrics.publish(&snapshot) ← 写共享单元
 ├─ ④ ledger.commit_step(metrics_changed)          ← 至多发出一条 StepOutputs
 ├─ ⑤ step == Err？
 │     是 → log::error → ledger.fail_all("engine fatal: {错误原文}")
 │          → ledger.commit_step(false) 把写销冲出去 → return（线程结束）
 │     否 ↓
 └─ ⑥ snapshot 空转（running == 0 且 waiting == 0）？
        submissions_open == false → log::info → return（排空退出）
        否则 → std::hint::spin_loop() → 回到 ①
```

三个容易错过的细节：

1. **致命迭代的「遗言」也会被发出**：`step` 返回 `Err` 前可能已经记了半步账（比如 `admit` 之后才崩）——L84 的 `commit_step` 在错误检查**之前**，所以这些部分更新先落地；随后 `fail_all` 只写销**仍然开着**的账户（已 finish 的不受影响），再由第二次 `commit_step(false)` 冲出去。线上顺序：部分更新 → `Failed` terminals。
2. **空转判定用的是本迭代的快照**：③ 拍的 `snapshot` 在 ⑥ 复用，不再重拍——`step` 之后到下一次 `step` 之间调度器状态不变（单线程独占），所以快照永远新鲜。
3. **「一条 `StepOutputs`」不等于「每迭代必有消息」**：`commit_step` 在「更新为空 **且** metrics 未变」时**不发**（见 4.2.3 的账本侧代码）。空转的迭代对外完全静默；而「metrics 变了但更新为空」会发一条 `updates` 为空的**唤醒消息**——这正是 wiring.rs 文档说的「metrics are a shared cell, with changes signaled on the step stream」。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果把 L84 的 `commit_step` 挪到 L81 的 `step` **之前**（先 commit 再干活），会破坏 u3-l3 的哪条保证？

**参考答案**：会拆碎「一步一条 `StepOutputs`」。commit 提前意味着上一步 `step` 记的账要等到**下一迭代开头**才发出——对外看，同一个调度器步的更新可能被拆进两条消息、或者本迭代 `step` 的新更新与上一迭代的残留混在同一条里；压扁结构 `RequestUpdate` 的「步内顺序」保证（u3-l3）建立在「一步的全部更新恰好在一步的末尾一次性发出」之上。此外致命路径也随之变形：`fail_all` 的写销将不得不与下一迭代纠缠。现在的顺序（step → commit）让「步」与「消息」严格一一对应。

**练习 2**：空转迭代为什么选择 `spin_loop()` 而不是 `thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))`？代价是什么？

**参考答案**：`sleep` 会让线程离开 CPU 至少一个调度量子（毫秒级），新到的提交要等睡醒才被排空——每个空闲后的首个请求平白多一毫秒尾延迟，这与「busy iterations never pause」「循环无停顿」的设计（2.1）冲突；`spin_loop` 是用户态提示指令，线程保持运行，下一轮 `try_recv` 几乎零延迟。代价是这一核在空闲期持续轻负载空转（不进低功耗状态）——对一个「随时可能有请求进来」的服务线程，工程上选择延迟优先。注释（[driver.rs:L99-L102](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L99-L102)）原话：「relax the core's issue slots before probing again. Latency is untouched — busy iterations never reach this hint」。

**练习 3**：为什么退出条件要求「提交通道 `Disconnected` **且** 最新快照 running/waiting 均为 0」，而不是通道一断就退出？

**参考答案**：`Disconnected` 只说明**前端不会再提交新请求**（所有 `SchedulerHandle` 已 drop），不说明手头的请求做完了。若通道一断就退出，仍在 running 的请求会瞬间失去调度器——它们的账户只能靠账本 Drop 扫尾拿到一个笼统的 `Failed`（u3-l4 的三层保护兜底），本可以正常完成的流被腰斩。「断连 + 排空」两个条件同时满足才退出，正是优雅关停的定义；[driver.rs:L211-L214](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/driver.rs#L211-L214) 的测试（drop handle 后 `join` 成功）验证的正是这条路径。

### 4.3 spawn_scheduler：铸接线、起线程、交回 LiveScheduler

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`Scheduler` trait 与 `drive` 循环之间还差一层**装配**：谁来把「一个裸的调度器值」变成「一个跑着的服务分区」？答案是一次调用：

```rust
let partition: LiveScheduler = spawn_scheduler("echo", EchoScheduler::default());
```

`spawn_scheduler` 做三件事：

1. **铸接线**：`scheduler_pair()` 一次铸出双端——前端端 `SchedulerHandle`、调度器端 `SchedulerBackend`（内含提交通道接收端、**崭新的账本**、metrics 发布器、退出守卫）。因为两端一体铸出，模型 crate 既不能接错线也不能忘接线（u3-l6 详讲）。
2. **起线程**：用 `std::thread::Builder` 起一个**命名** OS 线程跑 `drive(scheduler, backend)`——调度器值与 backend 一起被 move 进线程，从此单所有权。
3. **交回 `LiveScheduler { handle, join }`**：`handle` 是前端的交互面（提交/步流/metrics/`exited()`），`join` 是线程的 `JoinHandle`——按 [wiring.rs:L155-L160](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs#L155-L160) 的注释，它由 server 在关停时、**drop 掉全部 handle 之后** join。

「跑几个调度器、每个是什么含义（DP 副本？）」完全是模型线的决定，契约只搬运 `Vec<LiveScheduler>` 不附加 rank 语义——echo 线恰好一个（[echo-server.rs:L78-L92](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs#L78-L92)），qwen3 线可能按 DP 分区数 spawn 多个。

一次提交在接线路上的完整旅程（把 4.1/4.2 的循环串起来）：

```
前端侧                                   调度器线程（drive 循环）
──────                                   ──────────────────────
SchedulerHandle::submit(request)
 │ 铸 RequestId（原子自增）
 │ 铸 abort 标志 → RequestControl 返回给调用方
 │ 打包 RequestEnvelope（含 drop 炸弹 + queued_at）
 │ crossbeam send ──────────────────────→ ① try_recv 收到
 │                                          register(envelope) 开户
 │                                          scheduler.submit(queued)
 │                                       ② scheduler.step(&mut ledger)
 │                                          admit/push_tokens/finish…
 │                                       ④ commit_step → tokio mpsc send
 take_steps() 的接收端 ←────────────────── StepOutputs { updates }
 （协议栈翻译循环消费）
```

// 示例代码：EchoScheduler 的「每步两 token」变体
#[derive(Default)]
struct TwoTokenScheduler {
    queued: Vec<(RequestId, usize)>,
    running: Vec<(RequestId, usize)>,
}

impl Scheduler for TwoTokenScheduler {
    fn submit(&mut self, request: QueuedRequest) {
        self.queued.push((request.id, request.request.max_tokens)); // 只转移
    }

    fn step(&mut self, ledger: &mut RequestLedger) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        for (id, max_tokens) in self.queued.drain(..) {
            ledger.admit(id);                       // 裁决全在 step 里
            self.running.push((id, max_tokens));
        }
        let mut still_running = Vec::new();
        for (id, max_tokens) in self.running.drain(..) {
            if ledger.is_aborted(id) {
                ledger.retire(id);
                continue;
            }
            let next = ledger.completion_tokens(id) as u32;   // 读账本流水
            let batch: Vec<u32> = (next..(next + 2).min(max_tokens as u32)).collect();
            if batch.is_empty() {
                ledger.finish(id, FinishReason::Length);      // 上一轮恰好做满
                continue;
            }
            ledger.push_tokens(id, &batch, &[]);
            if ledger.completion_tokens(id) >= max_tokens {
                ledger.finish(id, FinishReason::Length);
            } else {
                still_running.push((id, max_tokens));
            }
        }
        self.running = still_running;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn metrics(&self) -> SchedulerMetrics {
        SchedulerMetrics {
            num_running_reqs: self.running.len() as u64,
            num_waiting_reqs: self.queued.len() as u64,
            ..SchedulerMetrics::default()
        }
    }
}

## 6. 本讲小结

- **`Scheduler` 三方法就是模型线的全部运行时义务**：`submit` 只做所有权转移（裁决延迟到 `step` 零代价，因为 driver 每迭代 commit 一次）、`step` 是唯一裁决点与唯一记账点、`metrics` 是 `&self` 只读快照；超出三方法的能力（如 LoRA 控制通道）由调度器自己捕获、在自己的 `step` 里排空。
- **`drive` 把循环纪律写成了代码**：每迭代固定四拍——排空提交（每条先 `register` 开户再 `submit` 转移）→ `step` → 快照并 `publish` metrics → `commit_step` 恰好一次；八条模型线共享同一份骨架，不存在八份人肉纪律。
- **「一条 `StepOutputs`」有三档**：有更新则带更新发出；无更新但 metrics 变了则发一条 `updates` 为空的**唤醒消息**（读者该去重读共享单元）；两者皆无则**完全静默**——空转迭代对外不可见。
- **致命路径**：`step` 返回 `Err` → 本迭代的半步账先照常 commit → `fail_all("engine fatal: {错误原文}")` 写销**每一个**未答复请求（含调度器跟丢的）→ 再 commit 一次冲出发送 → 线程返回，`exit_guard` drop 使 `handle.exited()` 解析。
- **退出与空闲**：优雅退出要求「提交通道断开 **且** 最新快照 running/waiting 均为 0」；空转迭代以 `std::hint::spin_loop` 放松发射端口但绝不睡眠——有活干的迭代永远到不了这条 hint。
- **`spawn_scheduler` 是装配点**：`scheduler_pair` 铸双端（前端 `SchedulerHandle` / 调度器 `SchedulerBackend`，账本出生即握步流发送端）→ 命名线程跑 `drive` → 交回 `LiveScheduler { handle, join }`；`handle.submit` 永不失败——调度器已死时由信封 drop 炸弹以 `Failed` terminal 作答。

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.
